page_title: seshka: kill what Claude Code left behind

sources.entry: Seshka - Open-source menu bar app that finds the dev servers, watchers, and browsers closed Claude Code sessions left running, and kills them. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/jigjoy-ai/seshka) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.name: seshka
summary.one_liner: seshka is a free, open source macOS menu bar app that finds and kills dev servers, watchers and emulators left running by closed Claude Code sessions.
use_cases: Kill dev servers left running after a Claude Code session closed
Free memory held by orphaned watchers and emulators
End idle Claude Code sessions automatically after a time limit
Remove git worktrees Claude Code created for its agents
Keep a Mac awake with the lid closed while Claude works
summary.what_it_does: seshka lists every process a closed Claude Code session left behind, showing each one's port, memory use, age and the git worktree it ran in. You can kill them with one click, and it reports how much memory was recovered. It also shows all open sessions, whether working or idle, and can end idle ones manually or automatically after a limit you set; ended sessions can be resumed with claude --resume. For disk, it can clean up git worktrees made for Claude Code agents, scratch files of closed sessions, and caches, with nothing removed without a click. An optional setting keeps the Mac awake while a session is working, with the lid closed, and lets it sleep when the last session finishes. It can also produce a shareable weekly picture of cleaned-up totals showing only numbers.
notable: Finds leftover dev servers, watchers and emulators by port, memory and age, and shows the git worktree each ran in
Ends idle Claude Code sessions in one click or automatically after a set limit; resumable with claude --resume
Keeps a closed-lid Mac awake only while a Claude session is working
caveats: Only available for macOS according to the page
